causes: Sequential Compose wait attached after short-lived services had already completed and returned a no-containers error despite both exit codes and outputs being zero.
Docker inspection represents network_mode none with a synthetic none network key, while the collector compared that key with the resolved Compose empty network list.
The post-run live-PID threshold assumed only Controller and verifier exit, but the two one-admission Baby servers also exit normally after their Controller clients close.
correctionPolicy: Retain every v5 artifact; poll the project-labeled container states directly; normalize network_mode none only when Docker also reports HostConfig.NetworkMode none; prospectively require the exact four successful terminal services and thirteen still-running services; and use a fresh v6 identity.
claimBoundary: The v5 functional path completed, but its registered topology gate failed. It is not a passing qualification, behavioral result, B12 closure, or publication evidence.
